verdicts.reason: Both restack the design sensibly. A has a readable logo and a strong headline. Its circle stops at the same left margin as the text, and 'Full review inside.' has comfortable space below it, though the circle runs almost the full canvas width and the badge sits close to the wordmark. B's headline is bigger but crowds the right edge on 'marathons'. Its logo is shrunk to a minor element, the circle is smaller and leaves odd empty space, and the small footer copy is jammed near the bottom edge.
